newsitem.title: GERMANY: Trinkaus raises Metro pref share rating.
newsitem.headline: Trinkaus raises Metro pref share rating.

text.p: Trinkaus Capital Management on Wednesday said it raised its rating on German retailer Metro AG's preference shares to buy for the first time from the earlier rating of outperform.

Trinkaus said the rating on the preference shares was upgraded after Metro said earlier on Wednesday that 1996 sales were steady at 62 billion marks and that it expected profit from ordinary activities at one billion to 1.1 billion marks.
Trinkaus specifically made the recommendation on the preference shares because it believed the dividend payout of 4.25 marks per share was secure.

The bank said Metro's results were in line with forecasts but said weak industry conditions prompted it to cut its 1997 earnings estimates for Metro to 8.50 marks per share from 10.75 marks and the 1998 estimate to 10 marks from 12 marks.
But Trinkaus said Metro was the best-positioned retailer in Germany to deal with the difficult economic conditions and that the retailer would have "overproportional participation" in any recovery.
